item.title: 002 Afghanistan. Stolen Subjectivity
item.description: Afghanistan became the second civilizational case study within The Asterisk Problem. This research investigates the mechanisms that allow societies to lose the ability to protect their own children, dismantle institutions of responsibility, and transform human beings into resources for survival.

item.title: 🌱☀️ Peaceful Life
item.description: Peaceful Life is a long-term visual series dedicated to human rights, children’s rights, the rights of nature, and the everyday moments that make peace possible.

item.title: ✯ Extra Credit Problem (The Asterisk Problem)
item.description: A multidisciplinary research framework examining countries and regions where freedom, human dignity, child protection, and individual agency face systemic challenges. Each case study maps the path from tragedy and diagnosis to recovery, subjectivity, and civilizational renewal.
